Plan: docs/phases/sonicgrid-result-models.md (Phase 13 / B5; roadmap entry in docs/roadmap.md). Adds admin.triageModel / localizationModel / fixModel to build_payload in sync/results.py per sonicgrid contract (Phase 52, PR #639 merged as 1e48ec1cf; 1-120 chars or null, strict schema).

Two corrections to the roadmap draft, both verified in code:
1. No double prefix: analyses.llm_model already stores the litellm string (ollama/..., anthropic/...; llm/client.py resolved_model), so the label is the model as-is when it starts with '<provider>/', else '<provider>/<model>' (§1).
2. fixModel is NOT read via fix_proposals.analysis_id: fix_proposer.py:345/450 sets that to the localization analysis. Instead: newest completed 'fix' analysis created no later than proposals[0].created_at. Exact because the fix analysis and its proposal are written back-to-back under db_write_lock (fix_proposer.py:437-457), _now() is strictly monotonic, fix_proposer is the only proposal creator, and the FIX_PROPOSING claim serializes fix runs per report (§2). Rejected alternative: a fix_analysis_id column + migration (still needs this derivation for legacy rows).

Fingerprint changes once per bug; revision max(last+1, epoch_us) means the re-push is applied, spread by triage_push_per_tick (§3). Rollout gate: sonicgrid #639 must be deployed to production before BOWIE runs this (old sonicgrid 400s every push and _push does not retry a 400 for the same fingerprint). No flag, no migration, no UI change. Test plan in §Testing (label rules, fix pairing incl. failed/no-proposal fix analyses, fake schema ADMIN_OPTIONAL, one applied re-push).

Approved. Reviewed docs/phases/sonicgrid-result-models.md against results.py, fix_proposer.py, db.py, llm/client.py, triage_sync.py, the fake schema, and the sonicgrid contract at 1e48ec1cf. The three optional model fields and limits match the receiving contract. Reusing the selected completed triage/localization rows preserves attribution; the proposed fix pairing is supported by the sole production proposal writer, adjacent analysis/proposal writes, and per-report claim. Avoiding the localization analysis_id is correct. Existing fingerprint and revision handling supports the planned one-time re-push without sync changes. Tests cover prefix normalization, missing metadata, length limits, proposal pairing despite subsequent unsuccessful attempts, strict-schema acceptance, and applied re-push followed by quiescence. Retain the explicit production deploy-order gate before BOWIE rollout; code availability alone does not establish that gate. Plan review only; no tests run.
